summary: Second firing of the day. The 06:30 slot had already written CONSTELLATION-2026-10-11.md, so this pass did not repeat the carry-forward and spent itself on the one item that report left unverified: the Rising performance action. It closed on evidence. The spatial index it asked for shipped at v0.59.59 as enemy_spatial.gd, and the per-unit scan cadence sits in the project optimization log under Tried but rejected, measured 2026-08-10 at 81 dictionary lookups per enemy. The lens had a scoping bug behind it: its template read docs/OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md for Here Be Hordes only, so the Brackish Rising log went unread every week; that line now covers both Godot projects and requires the rejected section. The plugin snapshot check was also tallying one row per session folder instead of one per skill, which is why the morning report published 28 splits across 32 skills and the same command answered 14 across 16 tonight. Both fixed. Open actions fell from three to two. The oldest item on the board is still the personal-skills upload in the desktop app, 11 days past its deadline and only Kane can click it.
